products.name: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM & DSPM for AI) — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Data Security Posture Management (DSPM & DSPM for AI) — surface sensitive-data risk, act on recommendations, and get visibility + controls over what Copilot/AI can access — so data-security posture is measured and improved. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See and reduce your data-security risk — including AI/Copilot exposure

You can't reduce data risk you can't see — and generative AI (Copilot) makes over-shared, unlabeled data newly dangerous. This solution implements Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) in Purview: the DSPM overview and recommendations, surfacing sensitive-data risk across the estate, and DSPM for AI — visibility into what AI/Copilot can access, prompts/responses touching sensitive data, and the policies to reduce oversharing before and during AI adoption — so data-security posture is measured and improved.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — DSPM (posture, recommendations, sensitive-data risk) and DSPM for AI (Copilot/AI data-access visibility, sensitive prompts/responses, oversharing controls).
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (licensing, DSPM roles, labels/DLP foundation, Copilot/AI in scope, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — enable DSPM, review posture + act on recommendations, turn on DSPM for AI, assess AI data-access + oversharing, and apply reduction policies (labels/DLP/access) — pilot-first, each action named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (risk surfaced, recommendations actioned, AI oversharing reduced) plus Best Practices for continuous posture improvement; AI-feature availability flagged to verify.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Data-security risk made visible and reduced — posture measured, recommendations actioned, and Copilot/AI oversharing surfaced and controlled — safer data before and during AI adoption.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVDSPM-AIExposure.ps1 — report AI/Copilot interaction activity and SharePoint/OneDrive oversharing (read-only)
    • PURVDSPM-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the controls that feed DSPM posture (read-only)
    • PURVDSPM-Reduce-Oversharing.ps1 — create/adjust oversharing-reduction controls, pilot-in-simulation-first (SAFE: -WhatIf by default)
    • PURVDSPM-ScopeConfig.ps1 — confirm DSPM scope, sign-in, auditing, and the features that feed posture (read-only)
    • PURVDSPM-Tracker.ps1 — snapshot DSPM recommendations and reduction-policy states for tracking (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
